messages:
dario: quick ask from PM 1: add a tiny "route budget" card that shows effective tokens, cache credits, and est $ for a route in one line.
maya: ok. what's the canonical source for "effective tokens"? raw tokens minus cache_saved?
dario: yes, effective = tokens - cache_saved. show both numbers. PM wants dollars too.
trent: we need model price mapping to compute est $. simplest: join minute-level rollups with model_price table. joins are heavy.
ui-sam: can we avoid the join by returning model_sku in the row and let UI multiply? reduces DB load.
dario: good idea. return model_sku and three string fields: "tokens","cache_saved","model_sku". client does usd math.
maya: client-side money calc could diverge over time if prices update. include a price_version tag on the payload so finance can reconcile.
trent: infra note: for large tenants the live query is 4-6s. propose a tiny materialized view with 1m rollup and ttl 30d. MV keyed by (tenant, route, minute).
ui-sam: UI mock: "1.2k eff | 400 cache | $0.014 (model:redwood-13b, price_v:2026-03-20)" expand -> mini-sparkline. keep it compact.
dario: alpha scope: top 30 tenants only, feature flag off-by-default. PM wants EOW demo but limited set is fine.
trent: ops: we'll need a recompute cron and a checksum column to detect stale data. also add a flag for excluding external proxy routes.
maya: attribution edge: prefetch cache shared across routes. propose proportional split by route hits in the minute window and surface a "confidence" tag (low/med/high).
dario: nice. add a tooltip: "prefetch attribution: estimated; see confidence".
trent: quota safety: if client requests many routes, fallback to sampling (1% traces) and mark results as sampled.
ui-sam: export: CSV for finance with price_version and checksum. tiny CTA in UI: "simulate 100% prefetch credit to this route" so users can see impact without changing runtime.
maya: owners: trent -> MV + API, dario -> API contract + feature flag, ui-sam -> UI prototype. sync tomorrow 9:30.
infra-bot: ticket COST-9001 created for route-budget-card.
dario: thanks everyone. ping here if any blockers.
